description: Search the curated template library (`divoom://templates/curated`): ~20 marketplace-derived watchface skeletons with tags such as weather, lunar_calendar, split_time_digits, pixel_theme, asset_heavy. Prefer cloning an existing ItemList layout before inventing raw coordinates. Filters support tagsAll/tagsAny, bucket, clockIds, item-count bounds, and dispPresent (template must include that disp id). Set includeWatchface=false for a compact summary without the full ItemList payload.

bucket.description: Pick list bucket label from the curated generator (e.g. split_time_digits, weather, pixel_theme).

dispPresent.description: Keep templates that already contain at least one row with this disp id.

includeWatchface.description: If false, omit the nested watchface.ItemList payload (default true).

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on NameCn or NameEn.

tagsAll.description: Template must contain every listed tag (AND semantics).

tagsAny.description: Template must contain at least one listed tag (OR semantics).

name: watchface_template_search
